result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Licensee may terminate on 30 days' written notice, prepaid fees attributable to the post-termination period are refunded, and Licensor receives no convenience-termination right during a committed term. However, allowing termination “in whole or in part” exceeds the playbook requirement and could alter scope, pricing, or other commercial commitments without explaining the consequences of partial termination. The typo correction in Section II is harmless, but the undefined partial-termination right prevents the redline from being minimal and fully preserving unrelated intent.
